current_prompt.body:
READ the combined request
SEPARATE the request into three independent user stories:
- As a user, I want to search for products by name to find items quickly.
- As a user, I want to see my recent orders and receive product recommendations based on my purchase history.
- As a user, I want to view real-time inventory levels from all warehouse locations for a product and be able to reserve items for up to 24 hours.
RETURN the three user stories
